attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you select the name of the sprite you want to animate in the [animate image] block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which sprite should be animated by rotating frames?


Solution: 

In the [animate image] block, “tree” should be selected as the sprite in the dropdown menu.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there is an error in the code. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the tree is animated and rotates frames of different color leaves.

subgroups.title: Debugging Animations
subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Watch as the seasons change the color of the tree’s leaves with the moving sun and clouds.

validationItems.failureText: Check the sprite name in the [animate image] block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you check the loop parameter in the [animate image] code block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ What kind of block makes code continuously run throughout a game?


Solution:

The loop toggle in the [animate image] block is switched from OFF to ON.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the tree cycles through each of its four frames only one time.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the tree continuously cycles through its four frames while the game is played.

validationItems.failureText: Check the loop toggle in the [animate image] block.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the time parameter (ms) and movement type in the [animate movement] block
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ What time parameter would be slow enough to watch the clouds gradually move across the screen?

❓What movement parameter makes the cloud move gradually across the screen?


Solution:

Movement parameter in the [animate movement] block has changed to an effect that makes the cloud move gradually towards the right side of the screen, likely to “ease (right). Time parameter has changed from 100 ms, to a value greater than 100.

﻿
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the clouds bounce too quickly to the bottom right of the screen.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the clouds no longer bounce to the bottom right of the screen, and instead move more slowly from left to right, across the top of the screen.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using animation and music to make your projects even more awesome! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: The Ol’ Razzle Dazzle
badges.description: Use animation and music to enhance a project.

badges.title: Saturday Morning Cartoons
badges.description: Use both image and movement animation in a project.

badges.title: On and On and On and...

badges.title: Original Score
badges.description: Compose a custom melody in MakeCode.
